[[Grawl Petitioner (warrior)|Grawl Petitioners]] are a variety of [[Grawl]] found in [[Regent Valley]].

*[[Ascalon]]
**{{NPC location|Regent Valley}}

==Skills==
*{{skill icon|Counter Blow}}
*{{skill icon|Heavy Blow}}

==Items dropped==
*[[Grawl Gear]]
*[[Ornate Grawl Necklace]]

==Notes==
* Grawl Petitioners do not appear to be allied to [[Grawl Heretic]]s, this could indicate an unexplained civil or religious conflict among the Grawl.
* A group of Grawl Petitioners including a [[Grawl Petitioner (monk)]] sometimes appear southwest of Fort Ranik and travels through the tar until they reach the ruined statue of [[Melandru]] near [[King's Watch]], where a [[Grawl High Priest]] awaits. If left alone, they will perform actions that seem to emulate praying.
